note: Flags appended after the core's own flags on every target compile and link (GCC uses the last -O). 'release' appends nothing; 'unless' lists tokens that, when already on a compile, mean the profile's flags are skipped for it.

release.description: The core's own optimization; with the universal board it reproduces the goldens.

max.description: Highest standard GCC level; IEEE-safe (no -Ofast). Never lowers a compile that already uses -Ofast.

debug.description: Unoptimized with full debug info; artifacts keep DWARF.

debug-og.description: Debuggable but fast enough to run heavy cores on device.

release-g.description: The core's own optimization plus debug info, for profiling and symbolized crashes.
